headline: Argentina Suspends ARCA Tax Seizures for SMEs Until May 2027
summary: Argentina's economy ministry announced the suspension of ARCA tax seizures for small and medium-sized enterprises until May 2027, alongside debt regularization measures.
why: Tax relief measures and debt restructuring frameworks for SMEs alter corporate cash flows and bankruptcy risks during economic stabilization programs.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Suspension of tax seizures eases short-term liquidity pressures on domestic SMEs.
